Longer pieces of work that have their own site.

## Open Talamh

[opentalamh.ie](https://opentalamh.ie) is an open, evidence-graded map of who owns land in Ireland, starting with the Catholic Church and State bodies. Every site traces back to a source record and gets a confidence grade, and anyone can send corrections or new sources. It has its own site so that its method and corrections process stand on their own.
